summary.en: Conan and the Detective Boys are visiting a group of university students who are members of the figure club. However, one of the students, Kazuya Shiraishi, is not happy with their visit, because they have a project that needs to be finished tomorrow. While Kazuya is working alone in the room, an explosion was heard and a blackout occurs. Conan tries to approach the room, but Naoto Mizuhara prevents him from going. A second explosion then occurs, and smoke is seen from the room. The door is locked, and Keiji Aoki asks Conan to call the fire department. Victim: Kazuya Shiraishi Cause of death: Smoke inhalation from Explosion Suspects: Naoto Mizuhara, Keiji Aoki, and Saki Midoriyama After hearing the two explosions, Naoto and Keiji futilely attempt to open the door and as a result Shiraishi dies from smoke inhalation. Unfortunately, Kazuya inhales a lot of smoke and passes away. The police later come to investigate the scene.
